edges.reason: msg.sender is stored as initial owner and beneficiary during construction.
msg.sender becomes the sender argument of _transfer through transfer/transferFrom.
burn() burns from _msgSender(), i.e. the untrusted caller.
claimOwnership requires msg.sender == proposedOwner before transferring ownership.
onlyOwner restricts setMinSupply to the owner address derived from msg.sender.
onlyOwner restricts setBeneficiary to the owner address derived from msg.sender.
onlyOwner restricts setFeesEnabled to the owner address derived from msg.sender.
onlyOwner restricts setExcludeFromFee to the owner address derived from msg.sender.
onlyOwner restricts proposeOwner to the owner address derived from msg.sender.
Constructor initializes minSupply to 100000000 ether.
Constructor sets beneficiary to msg.sender.
Constructor sets feesEnabled to false.
Constructor populates isExcludedFromFee for deployer and the router address.
Owned constructor stores msg.sender as owner.
Constructor assigns the total supply literal into the local variable.
_transfer calls calculateFee to derive burn and transfer fees.
_transfer invokes _burn(sender, burnedFee) when total supply is above minSupply.
_transfer forwards transferFee to the beneficiary via ERC20._transfer.
_transfer sends the remaining amount to the recipient via ERC20._transfer.
_transfer computes amount - transferFee - burnedFee for the recipient.
calculateFee executes (_amount * _fee) / 10000.
burn() calls the internal ERC20 _burn on the caller balance.
setMinSupply overwrites minSupply.
setBeneficiary overwrites the beneficiary state variable.
setBeneficiary calls setExcludeFromFee for the new beneficiary.
setFeesEnabled overwrites feesEnabled.
setExcludeFromFee writes into the isExcludedFromFee mapping.
proposeOwner stores the proposed owner, gated by onlyOwner.
claimOwnership moves proposedOwner into owner after the msg.sender check.
claimOwnership reads proposedOwner for the authorization check and event.
sender parameter flows through the _transfer logic.
recipient parameter flows through the _transfer logic.
amount parameter flows through the _transfer logic.
_amount parameter is used by calculateFee.
_fee parameter is used by calculateFee.
value parameter is burned in burn().
_newMinSupply parameter is assigned to minSupply.
_newBeneficiary parameter is assigned to beneficiary.
_enabled parameter is assigned to feesEnabled.
_account parameter indexes the isExcludedFromFee mapping.
_excluded parameter is written to the isExcludedFromFee mapping.
_newOwner parameter is assigned to proposedOwner.
transferFee is the return value of calculateFee for the 2% fee.
amount is the minuend of amount - transferFee - burnedFee.
amount is multiplied by the fee numerator inside calculateFee.
_amount operand of the multiplication in calculateFee.
_fee operand of the multiplication in calculateFee.
burnedFee is the amount burned from the sender.
burnedFee is subtracted from the transfer amount.
transferFee is the amount forwarded to the beneficiary.
transferFee is subtracted from the transfer amount.
_newBeneficiary is passed to setExcludeFromFee as the account argument.
_newBeneficiary ends up stored in the beneficiary state variable.
beneficiary is the destination of the fee transfer in _transfer.
recipient receives the net amount and must not be the token contract.
The burn inside _transfer only executes while totalSupply - burnedFee >= minSupply.
